baseline_definition.description: Full rational closure under tensor product R(ab) <= R(a)R(b), padding R(n) <= R(n+1), and border peeling R(n) <= R(n-1) + 3n^2 - 3n + 1, combined with the existing L=256 extended rectangular baseline (full256.p3.square.bin), seeded from all 100 catalogue.json entries, comparisons/primitives.json, upstream lita_current.py (even n >= 8), and unbounded upstream lita_odd_current.py (all odd n >= 9 with constant -11/2).

verification.layer1_crt_leaves: 100% C++ __int128 multi-prime CRT exact-Q verification (modulus > 2*Delta*S) on all 441 local exact-Q schemes and all 158 reachable non-LITA qcsr leaves.
verification.layer2_dag_audit: Independent C++ streaming DAG audit across all 641,243,628 search nodes + Python specialized op audit + cwschemes load-time exact-Q Brent verification of all serendipitous bud decompositions.
